(ii) The code converts the plan's sanctioned recovery path into a kill input: §"Allowed without asking" explicitly lists "checkpoint walk-back / band-entry fallback reads per §4.8" as recovery-mode, and §4.8(c) reserves failed-gate for "a cell that never passes at ANY checkpoint" — yet a fallback pair lands in `failed_gate_pairs` and counts toward `_classify_outcome`'s `n_targets - k_surviving >= 3` kill (analyze.py:657). It has the SAME trigger condition as finding 1's severity argument (surviving pairs at different fracs — strictly MORE likely than full fallback, since the per-pair walk-back moves pairs to different co-passing fracs independently), the plan itself states gaps vary ~30× across checkpoints, and `effect_above_noise_band` is a conjunct in BOTH the Success and the Null cell of §7 (success requires mean |d| > band; promotable null requires mean |d| within band), so a cross-frac comparison can misclassify the headline outcome in either direction.
